name: Comprehensive Mongolian (Pre-A1 - C2)
description: Authoritative 256-unit, 1,257-lesson pedagogical curriculum spanning Pre-A1 literacy through C2 scholarly philology.

sections.title: Cyrillic Script Literacy & Primary Vowel Systems
sections.cyrillicTitle: Монгол кирилл цагаан толгой ба үндсэн эгшиг
sections.theme: Enable the learner to read isolated Cyrillic characters, identify own name in Cyrillic, sound out simple one-syllable words, and operate a standard Mongolian Cyrillic keyboard.
sections.description: Establish foundational grapheme-phoneme correspondences for the 35 Cyrillic letters, mastering standard alphabetical collation, handwritten vs printed recognition, and the core 7 short vowels plus the distinct Mongolian letters Ө and Ү.

sections.title: Syllable Structure, Vowel Harmony & Emergent Survival Formulae
sections.cyrillicTitle: Үеийн бүтэц, эгшиг зохицох ёс ба анхан шатны хэллэг
sections.theme: Enable learners to greet peers and elders politely, introduce their own name, express simple thanks, and read signs displaying common names, public signs, and digits 1-10.
sections.description: Expand phonological competence to long vowel pairs, basic diphthongs, iotated vowels (я, е, ё, ю), masculine vs feminine back/front vowel harmony, and primary formulaic survival greetings.

sections.title: Identity, Courtesy & Nominal Equational Clauses
sections.cyrillicTitle: Танилцах, мэндлэх ба нэрийн өгүүлбэр
sections.theme: Introduce oneself and others, state nationality, profession, exchange elder salutations, apologize, and ask basic yes/no identity questions.
sections.description: Systematize basic personal identification, nationalities, occupations, and zero-copula equational clauses, polar questions, and negative nominal predication.

sections.title: Physical Space, Quantities & Locative-Accusative Predication
sections.cyrillicTitle: Орон зайн байршил, тоо хэмжээ ба заах-орших тийн ялгал
sections.theme: Describe classroom and domestic environments, ask where items or facilities are located, understand prices, shop for basic commodities, and report what is present or missing.
sections.description: Develop the ability to locate concrete objects in space, specify quantities and prices, express existence and absence (байна / байхгүй / алга), and distinguish definite direct objects with the Accusative case.

sections.title: Daily Routines, Movement & Temporal Sequencing
sections.cyrillicTitle: Өдөр тутмын хэв маяг, хөдөлгөөн ба цаг хугацаа
sections.theme: Discuss daily schedules, wake-up and work times, describe simple commutes, tell time, talk about days of the week, and narrate what happened earlier today.
sections.description: Introduce verbal inflections for daily routines, habituality (-даг), witnessed past events (-лаа), motion to and from locations using Ablative and Directive cases, and clock time.

sections.title: Food, Hospitality, Dining & Basic Social Exchange
sections.cyrillicTitle: Хоол хүнс, зочлох ёсон ба энгийн харилцаа
sections.theme: Order meals and beverages, ask about ingredients, settle bills, negotiate grocery purchases, express food likes/dislikes, and follow ger hospitality customs.
sections.description: Equip learners to navigate restaurant dining, food shopping, express preferences, make polite requests (-аарай), suggest collaborative actions (-я), and participate respectfully in Mongolian food hospitality.

sections.title: Kinship, Reflexive Possession & Immediate Surroundings
sections.cyrillicTitle: Гэр бүл, төрөл садан, өөрийн хамаарал ба хүрээлэн буй орчин
sections.theme: Describe family members, talk about relationships and marital status, describe one's home/ger, discuss the weather, and synthesize basic personal stories.
sections.description: Consolidate the A1 stage by mastering nuclear family kinship relations, genitive possession, possessive pronouns, progressive aspect (-ж байна), past perfective (-сан), and basic environmental descriptions.

sections.title: Urban Transit, Wayfinding & Public Space Encounters
sections.cyrillicTitle: Хот доторх зорчилт, зам асуух ба нийтийн үйлчилгээ
sections.theme: Navigate urban spaces, hail street taxis, purchase intercity bus and train tickets, understand transport announcements, and follow complex spatial directions.
sections.description: Equip learners to navigate Ulaanbaatar and provincial centres independently, use buses and taxis, ask multi-step directions, understand public transit schedules, and deploy directional cases and converbs.

sections.title: Commerce, Clothing, Tailoring & Service Appointments
sections.cyrillicTitle: Худалдаа үйлчилгээ, дэлгүүр хэсэх ба захиалга
sections.theme: Purchase clothes, traditional deel garments, exchange currency, open a bank account, send parcels, bargain at open-air markets, and schedule service appointments.
sections.description: Master interactions in markets, shopping malls, tailor shops, banks, and post offices, utilizing comparative and superlative structures, conditional converbs (-бал), and reflexive possession.

sections.title: Health, Wellness, Anatomy & Medical Encounters
sections.cyrillicTitle: Эрүүл мэнд, бие махбод ба эмнэлгийн тусламж
sections.theme: Describe illness symptoms, interact at pharmacies, schedule medical appointments, explain allergies, understand prescription dosages, and talk about healthy routines.
sections.description: Provide learners with the language needed to describe bodily symptoms, consult doctors, buy over-the-counter medicine, understand medical instructions, and express rules and obligations.

sections.title: Extended Family, Personal History, Social Invitations & Plans
sections.cyrillicTitle: Дурсамж өгүүлэх, урилга хүлээн авах ба төлөвлөгөө
sections.theme: Narrate past weekend and vacation experiences, describe childhood memories, introduce extended family, invite acquaintances to social gatherings, and report third-party conversations.
sections.description: Develop connected paragraph-level past narrative ability, social hosting, extending and declining invitations, reporting speech (гэж хэлэх), and expressing future intentions.

sections.title: Nomadic Pastoralism, Countryside Travel & Domestic Living
sections.cyrillicTitle: Нүүдлийн ахуй, хөдөө орон нутаг ба мал маллагаа
sections.theme: Communicate respectfully during countryside visits, understand herding terminology, discuss the five animals, describe housing and rental options, and manage travel logistics.
sections.description: Immerse the learner in the linguistic and cultural realities of rural Mongolia, nomadic livestock (Таван хошуу мал), ger etiquette, countryside homestays, and terminative converbs (-тал).

sections.title: Workplace Communication, Employment & Professional Processes
sections.cyrillicTitle: Ажлын байр, мэргэжлийн харилцаа ба албан хэрэгцээ
sections.theme: Present professional qualifications, participate in workplace meetings, write business correspondence, delegate tasks, report unexpected occurrences, and handle customer service issues.
sections.description: Launch the B1 threshold by developing professional communication skills, participating in job interviews, drafting formal emails, managing office workflows, and mastering causative and passive voices.

sections.title: Personal Biography, Opinion Discourse & Causality
sections.cyrillicTitle: Намтар, үзэл бодлоо илэрхийлэх ба шалтгаант холбоос
sections.theme: Express and defend personal viewpoints, critique books and films, outline causes and consequences of social phenomena, and speculate on hypothetical scenarios.
sections.description: Develop the ability to formulate nuanced opinions, express respectful disagreement, build structured arguments with causal and concessive connectors, and narrate complex biographical trajectories.

sections.title: Mongolian Geography, Regional Landscapes & Ecology
sections.cyrillicTitle: Монгол орны газар зүй, бүс нутаг ба байгаль орчин
sections.theme: Describe geographic features, plan travel itineraries across distant aimags, discuss climate change and pasture health, and understand regional cultural distinctions.
sections.description: Explore the geographic diversity of Mongolia across its 21 aimags, contrasting the Gobi desert, Altai mountains, and northern taiga, while discussing ecological challenges and regional traditions.

sections.title: National Celebrations, Naadam, Tsagaan Sar & Cultural Etiquette
sections.cyrillicTitle: Үндэсний их баяр наадам, Цагаан сар ба ёс заншил
sections.theme: Explain the rules and cultural significance of Naadam wrestling, horse racing, and archery; perform Tsagaan Sar greeting rituals (золгох); understand traditional blessings; report hearsay news.
sections.description: Deepen cultural competence through detailed exploration of Mongolia's two major national festivals: Naadam (The Three Manly Games) and Tsagaan Sar (Lunar New Year), focusing on ritual greetings, oral blessings, and evidentiality.

sections.title: Public Policy, Civil Society, Governance & Media Discourse
sections.cyrillicTitle: Төрийн бодлого, иргэний нийгэм ба хэвлэл мэдээлэл
sections.theme: Analyze news editorials, critique government policies, participate in formal structured debates, moderate panel discussions, and draft press releases.
sections.description: Advance to the B2 vantage level by analyzing contemporary public issues, municipal governance in Ulaanbaatar, media reporting, civil society debates, and complex discourse syntax.

sections.title: Ecological Dynamics, Climate Change, Dzud & Resource Economics
sections.cyrillicTitle: Уур амьсгалын өөрчлөлт, зудын эрсдэл ба тогтвортой хөгжил
sections.theme: Interpret statistical charts and environmental data, evaluate disaster management plans, discuss renewable energy, and negotiate commercial terms regarding resource stewardship.
sections.description: Deepen technical analysis of Mongolia's unique ecological vulnerabilities, the winter disaster (зуд) phenomenon, pasture degradation, renewable energy transitions, and mining resource tensions.

sections.title: Material Culture, Horsemanship, Morin Khuur & Performing Arts
sections.cyrillicTitle: Соёлын өв, морин хуур, уртын дуу ба уламжлалт урлаг
sections.theme: Critique artistic performances, analyze literary and musical aesthetics, discuss historical craftsmanship, and conduct cross-cultural comparative analyses of intangible heritage.
sections.description: Explore the aesthetic, musical, and artisanal dimensions of Mongolian heritage, focusing on the Morin Khuur (horse-head fiddle), Urtyn Duu (long song), throat singing (хөөмий), and horsemanship arts.

sections.title: Scholarly Critique, Rhetorical Structures & Academic Synthesis
sections.cyrillicTitle: Эрдэм шинжилгээний шүүмж, илтгэл ба найруулга зүй
sections.theme: Deliver academic conference presentations, handle grueling Q&A sessions, formulate research abstracts, comprehend commercial contracts, and mediate peer conflicts.
sections.description: Consolidate B2 mastery by preparing learners for academic and high-level professional intellectual work, including research presentations, academic abstracts, contract comprehension, and complex modality.

sections.title: Constitutional Law, Statutory Interpretation & Legal Discourse
sections.cyrillicTitle: Үндсэн хуулийн эрх зүй, хууль тогтоомж ба төрийн захиргаа
sections.theme: Parse statutory legal texts, draft administrative decrees, argue legal cases before formal panels, and evaluate statutory compliance.
sections.description: Inaugurate C1 operational proficiency through statutory analysis, constitutional interpretation, administrative chancellery syntax, and the rigorous register of statutory drafting and high court argumentation.

sections.title: Macroeconomics, Strategic Mining & International Commerce
sections.cyrillicTitle: Макро эдийн засаг, уул уурхай ба гадаад худалдаа
sections.theme: Analyze monetary and fiscal policies, evaluate mining feasibility studies, negotiate investment contracts, and write investigative economic journalism reports.
sections.description: Develop operational fluency in macroeconomics, mining concession negotiations (Oyu Tolgoi, Tavan Tolgoi), sovereign wealth fund management, and foreign trade policy.

sections.title: Diplomacy, Geopolitics & High-Register Epistemic Stance
sections.cyrillicTitle: Дипломат харилцаа, геополитик ба өндөр найруулга
sections.theme: Draft diplomatic communiqués, conduct bilateral negotiations, speak using elevated honorific verbs and nouns, draft formal speeches, and evaluate literary translations.
sections.description: Attain high C1 mastery in diplomatic protocol, third-neighbor foreign policy, honorific registers (хүндэтгэлийн үг хэллэг), philosophical discourse, and speechwriting for state statesmen.

sections.title: Contemporary Modernist Literature, Satire & Stylistic Nuance
sections.cyrillicTitle: Орчин үеийн уран зохиол, егөөдөл ба найруулгын торгон мэдрэмж
sections.theme: Comprehend and produce nuanced literary texts, appreciate rapid native banter and humor, dissect subtle political satire, and shift effortlessly across all registers.
sections.description: Achieve native-level mastery across contemporary literature, sophisticated irony, political satire, rapid spoken Khalkha phonotactics, colloquial conversational repair, and somatic idioms.

sections.title: The Secret History of the Mongols & Classical Philology
sections.cyrillicTitle: Монголын нууц товчоо ба сонгодог бичгийн хэлний өв
sections.theme: Read and analyze passages from The Secret History, trace the grammatical evolution from Middle Mongolian to Modern Khalkha, understand Pan-Mongolian dialects, and interpret historical monuments.
sections.description: Explore the linguistic, historical, and philological monument of The Secret History of the Mongols (1240 CE), Classical Mongolian grammar, archaic case morphology, and Pan-Mongolian dialectal variation.

sections.title: Gnomic Wisdom, Folk Epics, Ceremonial Blessings & Cosmology
sections.cyrillicTitle: Зүйр цэцэн үг, тууль, ерөөл магтаал ба гүн ухаан
sections.theme: Deploy proverbs with native precision, perform ceremonial blessings for milestones, appreciate epic heroic recitation, debate traditional cosmology, and achieve supreme authorial voice.
sections.description: Culminate the curriculum with mastery of oral epic literature (Jangar, Geser), ceremonial blessings (ерөөл, магтаал), gnomic proverbs (зүйр цэцэн үг), Tengrist and Buddhist philosophical concepts, and supreme authorial eloquence.
